answer: Operator-Linked Identity Lockout: bind each new agent identity to a scarce, auditable operator credential, so a sybil cluster collapsing under a gale of duplicate registrations freezes the operator's whole account rather than just the clone wallets. Any identity traced to a frozen operator inherits the freeze at the nebula stage of onboarding, before it can transact. An attacker must then acquire and maintain a distinct verifiable operator per identity, paying credential issuance and ongoing audit costs that scale linearly, pushing profitable sybil volume past its zenith.
